'''Nezzor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Nezzor was at the helm of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]] in the [[Battle of Ruan]] and won in a rousing success for the Empire. Following the battle of Ruan, Nezzor commanded the first wave of Imperial warships to [[Battle of Duro (Galactic War)|attack]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], however the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], who knew of the attack ahead of time, had waited for his fleet and laid out a carefully planned trap. During the battle, Nezzor's fleet suffered heavy losses and realizing the battle was lost, he attempted to ram his damaged ship into one of the many civilian orbital cities above Duro, but was obliterated in the process. Although Nezzor was considered by the [[Minister of Logistics]] [[Davidge]] an unprofessional sociopath, on contrary the [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Marr]] believed in Nezzor's tactical acumen.
